### 🚀 MacMate 1.0

MacMate brings your Mac and Android together with a native, fluid macOS experience.

#### 🎨 Brand New Identity & Modern Design
- Initial release of **MacMate**: "Your Mac and Android, in sync."
- Polished macOS 15 native UI with Liquid Glass vibrancy, refined materials, and responsive controls.
- High-resolution application icons across all standard macOS scales and the Share Extension.

#### 📡 Fast Discovery & Secure Pairing
- Resilient local discovery via Bonjour (mDNS) and UDP broadcast, connecting reliably across campus and office Wi-Fi.
- Direct IP and Tailscale mesh VPN discovery for seamless remote and cross-subnet connectivity.
- Secure TLS 1.3 pairing with cryptographic identity verification.

#### 📋 Clipboard, SMS & Notifications
- Instant two-way clipboard synchronization with sensitive data guards.
- Live Android notifications with inline quick-reply and one-click two-factor authentication (2FA) code copying.
- Full SMS conversation threads and instant messaging straight from your Mac.

#### 📁 Loopback NFS Phone Drive & Transfers
- Mount Android file systems directly into Finder via user-space NFS loopback.
- Zero-hang unmounting when devices go out of range or sleep.
- Fast multi-file transfer support from Finder and the macOS Share Sheet.

#### 🪞 Screen Mirroring & Media Remote
- Integrated scrcpy launcher for high-performance, low-latency screen mirroring.
- Media remote adapter with playback controls and lock-screen media information.
